verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to "automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository" (github-docs-38), and GitHub markets it as CI/CD (github-docs-11). Community comments describe Actions as GitHub's CI/CD offering with metered minutes (github-comm-19, github-comm-16), which corroborates the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that pipelines are defined as code files (e.g., a workflow syntax) and that they trigger automatically on push and pull_request events.
